title: Harden repository governance rules in automated checks
scope: backend test suite now checks tracked files for non-root markdown files and test or temporary scripts
only root README.md is accepted as tracked markdown
test, spec, tmp, temp, scratch, debug and local script paths are rejected for shell, PowerShell, cmd and bat scripts
production deployment scripts, normal Java tests and test resources remain allowed by classifier coverage
remaining: keep the PowerShell readiness script and JUnit classifier in sync if repository policy changes
